code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The frame bounds the region; the extra 3 marks the origin for alternating square rings.
    top = next(r for r in range(h) if any(grid[r][c] == 3 for c in range(w)))
    left = next(c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(h)))
    bottom = max(r for r in range(h) if any(grid[r][c] == 3 for c in range(w)))
    right = max(c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(h)))
    marks = [(r,c) for r in range(top+1,bottom) for c in range(left+1,right) if grid[r][c] == 3]
    sr, sc = marks[0]
    for r in range(top+1,bottom):
        for c in range(left+1,right):
            d = max(abs(r-sr), abs(c-sc))
            out[r][c] = 3 if d == 0 else (4 if d % 2 else 2)
    return out
'''
